message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (most common: 4). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each + 8 Wild cards. | | **Card Types** | 1. **Number cards** (0–9). 2. **Action cards**: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. 3. **Wild cards**: Wild, Wild Draw Four. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action or wild card, treat it as if it had been played by the dealer (e.g., a Skip means the first player is skipped). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you play a Wild card, you must declare the new color. | | **If You Can’t Play** | Draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played immediately, you may play it right away. If not, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card (i.e., you have one card left), you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each.
Winner of the round gets those points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – you can often anticipate what the next player will need to play. 2. **Use Wild Draw Four wisely** – it’s powerful but risky if you’re caught playing it illegally. 3. **Plan your “UNO” call** – if you’re about to lose a turn, make sure you’re ready to shout it on time. 4. **Keep the draw pile stocked** – if it runs out, reshuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
